_alerting_comment: Failure alerting is intentionally not wired here: GLPI configures SMTP in
the UI (Setup > Notifications), not via env, so the backup container has no
mail creds by default. To get failure emails, add a `mail` logger block
with adapter:env:* SMTP options and pass those vars into the `backup`
service in compose.yml.
Retention (phpbu's `cleanup` is one strategy per backup — capacity OR
outdated, not both):
glpi-db     — capacity 5G   (drop oldest dumps once the total exceeds 5 GiB)
glpi-files  — outdated 30D  (remove archives older than 30 days)
glpi-config — outdated 90D  (kept longer: tiny, and holds glpicrypt.key —
the AES key without which encrypted DB fields are unreadable)
Underscore-prefixed root keys are ignored by phpbu's loader — this block is
documentation only.
At-rest encryption: each backup has an openssl crypt step (aes-256-cbc,
pbkdf2) keyed by BACKUP_CRYPT_PASSWORD. The plaintext archive is deleted
after encryption, so the backups volume never holds the DB dump or
glpicrypt.key in the clear. Decrypt with:
openssl enc -d -a -aes-256-cbc -pbkdf2 -pass pass:$BACKUP_CRYPT_PASSWORD \
-in <file>.enc -out <file>.tar.gz   (then gunzip / tar -x)
Store BACKUP_CRYPT_PASSWORD OUTSIDE the backups volume — losing it makes
every encrypted archive unrecoverable.
